predictions.rationale: Core graph model for use–case diagrams; manages nodes (actors, use-cases) and their relationships, directly representing the diagram’s semantic structure.
Primary diagram class for use–case diagrams, orchestrating presentation, settings, and interaction; central to feature implementation.
Responsible for converting model elements (actors, use cases, relationships) into visual Figs; essential rendering component.
Initialises the use-case diagram subsystem, registering diagram type, renderer, and actions; foundational support for the feature.
Property panel specific to use-case diagrams, enabling user interaction and configuration; directly supports the feature’s UI.
Graphical figure class for individual Use Case nodes, handling their drawing and interaction in the diagram.
Graphical figure for Actor elements, a principal component of use-case diagrams; key to visual representation.
Handles visual depiction of «include» relationships between use cases; supports accurate diagram semantics.
Graphical representation of «extend» relationships, an integral part of use-case diagrams.
UI action that creates/opens a new use-case diagram from menus or toolbars; directly exposes the feature to users.
